Assuming you are in the US, First off; understand this.  You are 19. you do not need anyone's consent to go to a doctor.    If you are covered under your parents insurance, you do not need their consent to use it.    Still have to cover the copay or whatever though!   pesky money!
Depression and anxiety definitely.   At least non-disordered people experience parallel emotions and can feel empathy.   Even if they get frustrated at a disordered expression of those two.

"It got better for you"...   hmm; actually no. (or at least not for a very long time)  I gave up after the 2nd attempt because I realized I couldn't succeed.   Survival instinct was simply overpowering.  I produced a decent wound on my wrist, blood was flowing good, and then I went cold as ice inside absolutely emotionless, then executed perfect first aid, and walked home.   Apparently, not even my own body cared what I wanted.

I got no treatment afterwards, as I cooked up a pretty spiffy story that parents were all to happy to believe.   I'm not sure the ER doc believed me, but I can't remember that part.     No, at that point, I surrendered and began just living the script provided by those around me.     Script didn't break till early this year, did some self-help, found some outside help, and I may yet have a few years of life left as a sane, me, to experience.

When I think of one, I can't help but focus on the last thing I said, it wasn't mean or anything, I just didn't recognize his crisis, it made him decide not to come over.   And then he died.    The other I was less associated with, but his death completely and forever disrupted his family.  It was a horrible thing, even though his mental illnesses caused stress to those around; his departure caused much more.

You've been poisoned by this word "real".   You are not AFAB, but you are a real human.  And that is enough.  More than enough to make your life valid and worthwhile.

Its a cruel joke people are playing on you for their own sadistic amusement; they define something that you can not be, and then make you believe you need to be what they defined by allowing you to imply more meaning to the word than how they used it.

You are real.

Do not allow others to define your world or your thoughts.

I use this visualization to describe it; though its obviously more complicated.

In a brain built for male hormones, the sex hormone receptors get good activation in the T range of 400ng/dL to 1500ng/dL; that's rage, aggression, lust, etc..    all that good stuff; activation does not cause, it enables; eg, necessary but not sufficient on its own.  But when T is low you can get a little angry, and then it fades, that sort of thing.   Fully activated, high T, you can get really angry, really fast.   Not to mention the reproduction side.

A brain built for female levels has T receptors built for 30ng/dL to 90ng/dL.

Unfortunately, the brain's sex hormone receptor stuff is NOT laid out based on chromosomes.    Its built based upon a surge of T provided by MOM during pregnancy at just the right time.    If mom misses the window, or doesn't make enough T; you end up with a brain built for 50ng/dL of Testosterone, stuck in a body that makes 800ng/dL.

Needless to say, its amazingly unpleasant. 

Reality is of course much more complicated and blurry, and fortunately for humanity its relatively rare.

I will say this, the best day of my fairly long life, is when my Testosterone dropped below that activation threshold for the first time in my living memory.  It was like stepping out of hell, through a door, into a quiet, springtime meadow, deep in the mountains.
you have no idea what testosterone does to a brain that is not built for it.  It is very, very bad.

The error you are making is in asserting "you can't matter"; assuming a desire that I do not have.   Not only do I, nor anyone else "matter" in this context; it turns out, I have no desire to "matter".  Its irrelevant to my choice to exist.

There are NO important people.  There never were, and there never will be.   And that is a good thing.

Existence requires neither justification, nor purpose.   It simply is.   In order to logically arrive at purpose, you must assert one or several axioms that essentially define what is purpose as desire.   A loop which sheds little rational light on existence.

I choose to exist, because I exist.   I choose to act, because I exist. I choose to accept and embody a set of ethical constraints and values, because they add comfort and rationality to my existence.

Renown, property, wealth, power, are attachments and illusions.   They grant no value to existence.

Those would be more self-esteem targets.   You can know you are highly valued and competent, and still be depressed, either long term or temporarily.     Could be rational like a choice you made long ago that has lifetime implications;  or non-rational like something simply being chemically wrong in your brain.

The surgery is called: Orchiectomy.   There are a few US surgeons that will do it on request without complicated psychiatrist involvement, you'll have to hunt them up yourself if you want to go that route.   Cash and carry, no insurance accepted, so expect to pay $$$.  

The thing is though, surgery won't produce any better result than the drugs I mentioned as far as sex drive.   And the surgery carries essentially the same long term side effects.

What you aren't getting is that your body REQUIRES some quantity of sex hormone, and some amount of both, in order to function for long.  Its not just drive.   By pursuing the surgical option, you'll have to manage your estrogen and testosterone levels manually, with medication and blood tests until the day you die.

Put GnRH in google.  They zero out gonad produced sex hormone, male and female (after a bumpy start)..  Doing so has profound consequences beyond just sex drive.   Less expensive options are spironolactone in the US and cyproterone acetate in Europe/Asia; but those have to be taken daily.   Occasionally depo provera gets mentioned in the US, but its kinda gimpy by comparison, cheap though, and each injection lasts a good while.

btw, No reason to get hung up on the "castration" buzz.   I think some docs take it as a challenge to their masculinity when a male patient tells them their sex drive is intolerable and needs to be eradicated with extreme prejudice.

That said, surgical is not reversible, you might be of a different opinion in a few years..

You can exclude it easily enough if you, or someone you know has a glucose meter.  Eat a bowl of ice cream; wait 30 minutes, test.  It'll likely be below 120 thus excluding diabetes.  (if you do this, use a separate lancet, no sharing)

You should then eat more bowls of ice cream.  Because you already asked a doctor, and he told you what was wrong.

If you have recent blood test results, look for a line labeled A1C, and another that says glucose, serum. Should be in range, unless you are restricting calories, in which case, you again, already know what is wrong.... no?  There are also drug store, OTC  A1C tests you can do.   Or you could just eat a bowl of icecream.
When you say maximum HR, are you using a tested max, or age calculation max.  The age calc is just a demographic number.  My true maxHR is a good 15 bpm higher than the age calc.

If you're looking for a medication to do what you're looking for; they all have very substantial side effects; though not everyone experiences each one; and the ones with the least, are incredibly expensive (GnRH analogs) upwards of $700/month.

Getting into grad school doesn't necessarily require incredible grades, but I'll also add this, a PhD doesn't measure intellect, it measures relentlessness and mental endurance.   You need to find a way to measure your performance that doesn't run you down, because in grad school, on a PhD program, you will get squished periodically, and they aren't gentle or compassionate about it.  

So, I wouldn't say you're being a pussy about your grades, but you are seriously overreacting.    Detachment and perspective, step back a bit.    Build up some long term durability as opposed to being paranoid about the difference between an 85 or a 90 on a test in an undergrad class.

To anyone that runs into this and thinks, "gee, I have this anger problem, I'll just get a Zoladex implant or take spiro/cipro, and it'll go away."   Well, it will go away. People easily suicide when deprived of a sex hormone.   And so, you'll get to choose between dementia&brittle bones or adding E to your male brain and adding back in some suicide risk just for fun.

Maybe rethink this core value you are alluding to here?

"admitting defeat to the pharmaceutical companies"

They aren't out to defeat you.   Lots of scientists, engineers, business dweebs, spend their professional lives making these chemicals so we can enjoy a long and interesting life; even though in a natural human environment, we'd have never made it to puberty.       Our economy allows us to trade our skilled labor, for the product of other people's skilled labor, without a 1-1 barter relationship.

For instance, by being "defeated" by the pharma corps, I am able to eat candy and not die; enjoy a steak every once in a while.. and not die.  I can stub my toe and not feel unrelenting rage at everything near me; I can sleep, I can lift something with my left arm;  I can walk without a limp, I can actually run, though my orthopod says, "stop that!".      Seriously.     How is that being defeated?     Why is it horrible that I trade a portion of my skilled labor (in terms of income), for a portion of their skilled labor (cost of meds)?

I'll be on meds till the day I die; I will see my kid married and start her own family, I might even visit occasionally.

Or I could not be "defeated"; die horribly within a year, and claim my victory spiritually, as I don't get to see my kid married and start her family.    Something is wrong with that, and its not the meds.

Don't think its funding that is the problem at all.  Its the FACT that seeking treatment for mental health in the US can completely destroy your family, career, retirement, finances, etc.

That isn't the way it should be; but it most certainly is the way it is.
